decision.reason: [ev-4e7b065b85d5] confirms that a family of legacy `--log_rotate_*` flags was removed, so exposure in principle means "one of those flags is set on a product workload". It does not list the actual flag names or say which components (istiod, proxy/pilot-agent, others) accepted them. The proposed leaf uses the literal glob `--log_rotate_*` as the flag name. A cli-flag leaf matches a concrete argument name, so this condition would probably miss every environment that sets a real flag such as `--log_rotate_max_age`. Deciding the condition needs the list of concrete `--log_rotate_*` flag names and the components that accepted them, for example the 1.23 flag definitions.
